comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 3bcad57. The gate output has a real fault: on the flat distribution the drawn value is rangeval*5*random::uniform(), which reaches at most five volts times the range knob, and it is compared against a hard-coded 2.5, so the gate can only ever fire when that knob is past its own middle, and at the default of 0.5 it never fires at all. On the bell distribution the comparison is against zero, which is the middle of that spread, and the gate fires about half the time. The hold-time CV is added to an integer sample count rather than to the parameter, so one volt is one sample whatever the sample rate. The panel prints Noise Pitch over the hold-time knob and -10V/+10V over the distribution switch, which are descriptions of the effect rather than names of the control. Nothing is named: configParam and the port configs were all called with an empty name.
